Coram : Y.K. SABHARWAL*, H.K. SEMA
B Penal Code, 1860: Sections 3021149, 2011149, 147 and 148-Murder by 8 accused­ Evidence of eye witnesses-Trial court convicted 6 accused and acquitted 2 C accused-High Court convicted 4 of the 6 accused u/ss 302 and 201, convicted one of them u/s 201 and acquitted him u/s 302/149; acquitted facts and circumstances of the case all the 6 accused liable to be convicted-Acquittal of 2 of the 6 accused by High Court not D justified-Hence, judgment of High Court set aside and that of trial court 1 restored Criminal trial: Non-identification of dead body, failure to establish cause of death
Decision Date : 29-08-2002 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 619/2000 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
